name: IC Sensor — Sensortech
description: IC sensor cluster featuring surface-mount parts using the Sensortech_MiCS_5x7mm_P1.25mm footprint, represented by the MiCS-5524.
selection_hints: Designing with SMD IC sensors requiring the Sensortech_MiCS_5x7mm_P1.25mm footprint.
Selecting parts sourced from kicad-symbols or dist-legacy libraries.
Choosing between tier B and tier C parts, such as the MiCS-5524.
avoid_when: Through-hole or non-SMD mounting is required.
A footprint other than Sensortech_MiCS_5x7mm_P1.25mm is needed.
Tier A validated parts are strictly required for the design.
